SAA 9 001 (P333952), Parpola 1997, translation

(ruling)[o i 1'][......] strong (f.) [o i 2'][......] is wide (f.) [o i 3'][......] ...(ruling)
(ruling)
[o i 4'] [Esarh]addon, king of the lands, fear [not]!
[o i 6'] What wind has risen against you, whose wing I have not broken? Your enemies will roll before your feet like ripe apples.
[o i 11'] I am the Great Lady; I am Ištar of Arbela, who cast your enemies before your feet. What words have I spoken to you that you could not rely upon?
[o i 18'] I am Ištar of Arbela. I will flay your enemies and give them to you.
[o i 20'] I am Ištar of Arbela. I will go before you and behind you.
[o i 24'] Fear not! You are paralysed, but in the midst of woe I will rise and sit down (beside you).
(ruling)
[o i 28'] By the mouth of Issar-la-tašiyaṭ of Arbela.
(ruling)
[o i 30'] King of Assyria, have no fear! I will deliver up the enemy of the king of Assyria for slaughter. [I will] keep you safe and [make] you [great in] your Palace of Succession.[o i 36']I am the Gr[eat Lady. I am Ištar o]f Arbela [o i 37'][ ......] from his midst((Break))
[o ii 2'] What [......] I would not have heard you? [The enemies ...] in neck st[ocks, [the vassals] under tribu[te]; I defea[ted] your enemy in a single [encounter].
[o ii 8'] I have given you faith, I do not sit (idle)!
(ruling)
[o ii 9'] By the mouth of the woman Sinqiša-amur of Arbela.
(ruling)
[o ii 11'] I rejoice with Esarhaddon, my king; Arbela rejoices!
(ruling)
[o ii 13'] By the mouth of the woman Remutti-Allati of Dara-ahuya, a town in the mountains.
(ruling)
[o ii 16'] Fear not, Esarhaddon! I am Bel. (Even as) I speak to you, I watch over the beams of your heart.
[o ii 20'] When your mother gave birth to you, sixty great gods stood with me and protected you. Sin was at your right side, Šamaš at your left; sixty great gods were standing around you and girded your loins.
[o ii 27'] Do not trust in man. Lift up your eyes, look to me! I am Ištar of Arbela; I reconciled Aššur with you. When you were small, I took you to me. Do not fear; praise me!
[o ii 34'] What enemy has attacked you while I remained silent? The future shall be like the past. I am Nabû, lord of the stylus. Praise me!
(ruling)
[o ii 40'] By the mouth of the woman Bayâ, 'son'(!) of Arbela.
(ruling)
((Break))[o iii 2']I will [......] [o iii 3']you shall [.....]. [o iii 4']I am Mu[llissu (...)].(ruling)
[o iii 5'] By the mouth of the woman Ilussa-am[ur] of the Inner City.
(ruling)[o iii 7']I am Ištar of [Arbela]. [o iii 8']Esarhaddon, king of A[ssyria]! In the Inner City, Nineveh, Calah and Arbela I will give long days and everlasting years to Esarhaddon, my king.[o iii 15'] I am your great midwife, I am your excellent wet nurse. For long days and everlasting years I have established your throne under the great heavens.
[o iii 23'] I watch in a golden chamber in the midst of the heavens; I let the lamp of amber shine before Esarhaddon, king of Assyria, and I watch him like the crown of my head.
[o iii 30'] Have no fear, my king! I have spoken to you, I have not lied to you; I have given you faith, I will not let you come to shame. I will take you safely across the River.
[o iv 5] Esarhaddon, rightful heir, son of Mullissu! With an angry dagger in my hand I will finish off your enemies.
[o iv 11] O Esarhaddon, king of Assyria, cup filled with lye, axe of two shekels!
[o iv 14] Esarhaddon! I will give you long days and everlasting years in the Inner City. O Esarhaddon, I will be your good shield in Arbela.
[o iv 20] Esarhaddon, ri[ghtful] heir, son of Mul[lissu]! I am mindful of you, I have loved you greatly.
[o iv 26] I keep you in the great heavens by your curl. I make smoke rise up on your right side, I kindle fire on your left.
[o iv 33] The kingship [is] stro[ng] on [......]
((Break))
[o v 1] [......] shall not receive [...] from him. I will cut the conspiring weasels and shrews to pieces before his feet.
[o v 8] You (f.) are you. The king is my king!
(ruling)
[o v 10] By the mouth of the woman Issar-beli-da''ini, a votaress of the king.
(ruling)[o v 12]I am the Lady of Arbela. [o v 13]To the king's mother: [o v 14]Because you implored me, saying: "You have placed the ones at the (king's) right and left side in your lap, but made my own offspring roam the steppe" —[o v 21] Now fear not, my king! The kingdom is yours, yours is the power!
(ruling)
[o v 24] By the mouth of the woman Ahat-abiša of Arbela.
(ruling)[o v 26]All is well with Esarhaddon, king of Assyria. [o v 27]Ištar of Arbela has gone out to the steppe and sent (an oracle of) well-being to her calf in the city.[o v 31] At [her] coming out [......]
((Break))[o vi 1][Fear not, Esarhad]don! [o vi 2][I am the Lady of Arb]ela. [o vi 3][O Esarhaddon, whos]e bosom [Iš]tar of Arbela has filled with favour! Could you not rely on the previous utterance which I spoke to you? Now you can rely on this later one too.[o vi 13] Praise me! When daylight declines, let them hold torches! Praise me before them!
[o vi 21] I will banish trembling from my palace. You shall eat safe food and drink safe water, and you shall be safe in your palace. Your son and grandson shall rule as kings on the lap of Ninurta.
(ruling)
[o vi 31] By the mouth of La-dagil-ili of Arbela.
(ruling)
